pairs.why: A's stack of maps is slightly larger and more tilted on the diagonal, nearer the real card's big angled hero, but the two are very similar.
B's backpack fills more of the card with tighter margins, like the real card's large hero. A's pack is smaller, and its top handle loop pushes it taller than the body.
B's rover is chunkier and larger, with the body centered and the wheels near the lower edge. A's rover sits smaller in a wide ground plane.
A's cooler fills most of the card at close range like the real one, though the starfish and ball add minor clutter. B's cooler is small and wide with lots of empty sand and sea around it.
B's drum kit is larger and spreads nearly edge to edge like the real card. A's kit is smaller, with more empty space around it.
A's table and stools are big and close to the camera, filling the card like the real hero. B's table is a small, distant, centered object with a lot of empty lawn.
A's rope coil is one large tilted mass filling the card with a clear first read. B's two loose rings are spread out, smaller, and read as separate shapes.
A's lamp body is larger and angled like the real one. B's heavy truss across the top competes with the lamp and the lamp ends up smaller.
